title: David and Bathsheba
description: David sins with Bathsheba and sends her husband Uriah to his death. The prophet Nathan confronts him about his sin, and the child conceived dies, but Bathsheba later gives birth to Solomon.

versions.reason: [major] references: The proposal overlaps significantly with existing narratives 'Nathan rebukes David' (2 Sam 12:1-25) and 'Nathan's parable of the poor man's lamb' (2 Sam 12:1-15). However, this proposal also covers 2 Sam 11 (David and Bathsheba, Uriah's death), which is not fully covered by the existing ones. Merging them into one cohesive story about David and Bathsheba is most appropriate.
